name: word-frequency-counter
purpose: Analyze text.txt to generate word frequency statistics in freq.txt and report distinct word count.
instructions: Read the file 'text.txt' from the workspace. Count the occurrences of each distinct word. Sort the words by frequency in descending order; if frequencies are equal, sort alphabetically. Write the results to 'freq.txt' with one line per word in the format 'word count'. Finally, reply with only the integer representing the total number of distinct words found. Do not output any other text, explanations, or markdown. If 'text.txt' does not exist, reply with 'ERROR'.
